column7: Audit-before-disclosure under a full data volume (real built server, SQLite, RLIMIT_FSIZE): every secret value disclosed while writes fail has its own secret.read audit row after a restart (WAL recovery), and value reads go on until their audit write fails and they are refused (HTTP 500, "audit write failed for secret read" logged for each). Not a violation: the macOS failure (2026-10-17) was one read whose audit commit legitimately fit in WAL bytes a failed write had left below the limit; its row was durable (present after kill -9 + recovery, integrity_check ok, verify-audit VALID). ulimit -f units are now measured (dash 512 B, macOS sh 1024 B).
